title: overlay_check's Demo_Replay literal still omits growth_on — the same flag-threading residual class the r2-W1 fold just fixed for advance_gate_on
detail: demo_apply_setup reads cfg.growth_on, but this literal never sets it, so overlay-check re-sims `growth on` demos growth-off — the verification frame shows the wrong sim, the exact failure mode the r2-W1 comment cites for advance_gate_on. Pre-existing (5.7), PP_DEBUG-only.
recommended_fix: Add `growth_on = d.growth_on,` beside the advance_gate_on line; better, centralize Demo→Demo_Replay mirroring in one constructor (load_demo_replay already fills every field) and have overlay_check use it.
